best: The Cells and Gauge sheet draws the pack current path left to right with labelled charge/discharge FETs, cell-sense RC filters stacked by the gauge inputs, and a clear prose note on how the protection works.
worst: USB sheets leave many parts floating and tied only by labels (U405 caps, TVS D401, EEPROM U402, Q409, R454, R432/EN_5V1, supply decoupling groups marked 'for U405.VBIAS') with large empty regions on the page
MCU sheet has overlapping net labels (3V3_SLEEP label on top of its wire label), pull-up values placed far from their resistors, and the antenna-match title sits well below its pi network
Most of the BQ25756 charger is labels and long parallel buses into the IC, so the controller-to-power-stage connections (HG/LG, SW, BTST, sense) must be traced by name rather than seen
